_meta.description: UI texts for HAR.ZAP - edit labels and tooltips here

har_uploader.label: Upload HAR file
har_uploader.help: Upload a HAR (HTTP Archive) file captured from browser DevTools. Press F12 > Network > Export HAR

scope_domains.label: Scope domains (one per line)
scope_domains.help: Limit scanning to these domains only. Leave empty to scan all domains found in HAR

exclude_domains.label: Exclude domains (one per line)
exclude_domains.help: Skip these domains during scanning (e.g., analytics, CDN)

scan_types.label: Scan Types
scan_types.help: Select which vulnerability categories to test for

full_assault.label: FULL ZAP ASSAULT (All Policies)
full_assault.help: Enable all ZAP scan policies. Warning: slower but more thorough

analyze_btn.label: Analyze HAR
analyze_btn.help: Parse HAR file and extract endpoints, tokens, and parameters

target_select.label: Select targets
target_select.help: Choose which endpoints to scan from the analyzed HAR

launch_scan_btn.label: Launch ZAP Scan
launch_scan_btn.help: Start active scanning with OWASP ZAP proxy

har_user_a.label: HAR file for User A
har_user_a.help: HAR capture from first user session (e.g., admin)

har_user_b.label: HAR file for User B
har_user_b.help: HAR capture from second user session (e.g., regular user)

parallel_workers.label: Parallel Workers
parallel_workers.help: Number of concurrent requests for IDOR testing (higher = faster but more load)

run_idor_btn.label: Run IDOR Detection
run_idor_btn.help: Compare responses between users to detect Insecure Direct Object References

launch_redteam_btn.label: Launch Red Team Attacks
launch_redteam_btn.help: Execute selected offensive security tests against the target

fuzzing_type.label: Fuzzing Mode
fuzzing_type.help: Smart: auto-detect targets from HAR. Custom: manually specify URL and parameter

custom_param.label: Parameter to fuzz
custom_param.help: Parameter name to inject payloads into

wordlist_choice.label: Wordlist
wordlist_choice.help: Select payload source: IDs, usernames, emails extracted from HAR

export_wordlists_btn.label: Export to ./wordlists/
export_wordlists_btn.help: Save extracted tokens as wordlist files for external tools

run_passive_btn.label: Run Passive Analysis
run_passive_btn.help: Non-invasive security checks: headers, cookies, sensitive data exposure

risk_filter.label: Filter by Risk
risk_filter.help: Show only alerts of selected severity level

stop_zap_btn.label: Stop ZAP Container
stop_zap_btn.help: Terminate the running ZAP Docker container

methods_filter.label: HTTP Methods
methods_filter.help: Include only requests with these HTTP methods

content_types_filter.label: Content Types
content_types_filter.help: Include only requests with these content types

exclude_static.label: Exclude static resources
exclude_static.help: Skip .js, .css, images and other static files

domains_filter.label: Include domains
domains_filter.help: Only process these domains (one per line)

status_codes_filter.label: Status codes
status_codes_filter.help: Only include responses with these status codes (comma-separated)

preprocess_btn.label: Preprocess HAR
preprocess_btn.help: Apply filters and extract structured data from HAR

output_filename.label: Output filename
output_filename.help: Name for the preprocessed output file

save_unified_btn.label: Save Unified File
save_unified_btn.help: Save all extracted data in a single JSON file

save_granular_btn.label: Save Granular Extracts
save_granular_btn.help: Save each data type in separate files

criterion_type.label: Criterion type
criterion_type.help: Type of acceptance check to add

max_high_threshold.label: Maximum allowed High alerts
max_high_threshold.help: Fail if more than this many High severity alerts found

max_medium_threshold.label: Maximum allowed Medium alerts
max_medium_threshold.help: Fail if more than this many Medium severity alerts found

url_pattern.label: URL pattern
url_pattern.help: Regex pattern to match against scanned URLs

evaluate_btn.label: Evaluate Acceptance
evaluate_btn.help: Check if scan results meet all defined acceptance criteria
